'''Rajshree Pathy''' (born 15 April 1956) is an Indian entrepreneur from [[Coimbatore]], [[Tamil Nadu]]. She is the chairperson and managing director of the Rajshree Group of Companies and founder of India Design Forum.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.livemint.com/2012/02/24204127/The-business-of-design.html|title=The business of design|publisher=[[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]]|date= 24 February 2012}}</ref> The Rajshree Group has varied business interests, including food and agriculture, energy, travel, health, hospitality and the arts. Pathy also promotes performing arts and contemporary art movement in [[Coimbatore]] through the Contemplate Art Gallery and COCCA.

==Early life==
Rajshree Pathy is the daughter of famous industrialist G. Varadaraj, of [[PSG College of Technology|the PSG family]], who are [[Telugu people|Telugus]].<ref>{{Cite book|last=|first=|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=WXJDAAAAYAAJ&q=psg+rangaswamy+naidu+telugu|title=Journal of Indian History|date=2006|publisher=Department of History, University of Kerala|isbn=|location=|pages=181|language=en}}</ref> She is married to S. Pathy, chairman and managing director of [[Lakshmi Mills]].

==Professional career==
Rajshree Sugars and Chemicals Ltd. is a company with interests across integrated fields such as [[sugar]], [[distillery]], power generation and [[biotechnology]]. It was founded by her father G. Varadaraj.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/business-34712846|title='I'm a daughter – I'm not allowed to participate'|last=Kannan|first=Shilpa|date=2015-11-04|newspaper=BBC News|language=en-GB|access-date=2016-12-08}}</ref> Rajshree range of products includes white sugar, alcohol, organic manure, bio-products and power.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.livemint.com/Leisure/mKdwn6I9JXqOcEn0fvfiBM/She8217s-not-just-a-sugar-baroness.html|title=She's not just a sugar baroness – Livemint|website=www.livemint.com|access-date=2016-12-08}}</ref>
